prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square photographic artwork printed inside an indie vinyl record sleeve, part of a coherent series of three. Create the artwork ONLY, edge-to-edge, square format. Style: an art-directed fine-art still-life photographed on medium format film, subtly grainy, poetic and tactile, restrained contemporary record-cover photography, soft natural studio light with deep sculptural shadows, believable physical materials, carefully composed negative space. No text, no lettering, no logos, no record player, no vinyl, no album sleeve, no frames, no mockup, no watermark, no people. The photograph itself fills the entire image. Subject: a single architectural flight of five broad translucent pale blue glass steps, ascending diagonally from the lower-left into a bright hazy sky, set in a shallow calm pale blue water pool. A subtle warm white light comes from the far horizon. Close architectural composition, quiet brutalist geometry, blue glass refraction and soft sun shadows. Color palette: mist blue, denim blue, chalk white, a hint of silver. Mood: hopeful, an open path ahead. Minimal, abstract, beautiful.
